lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke wanders through an endless mist.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Where am I? How long have I been walking?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I was... I was looking for something. Someone?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the memory feels distant, like a dream.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: No, I can't forget. I have to find him.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But which way? Everything looks the same.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke walks in what he hopes is a straight line.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Through the mist, Luke sees the outline of a town.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But as he gets closer, something feels wrong.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But there! That building! It's... it's a store!
